title: Photo Service API
shortDescription: One photo API behind every capture point. It collects images from booths, photographers, and visitor uploads and passes them on to the services that need them: galleries, print, email, cloud storage, or the client's own systems.
longDescription: A service layer between the capture modules and everything that happens to a photo afterwards. Images from photobooths, roaming photographers, and visitor uploads arrive in one place, get the right frame, format, and visitor link, and are then handed on through a simple API: to a personal gallery or download link, a shared wall, a print service, an email or social share, cloud storage, or the client's CRM and marketing tools. New services plug in without changing the capture setup, so one event can feed many channels and the same pipeline can be reused from project to project. Sources, processing rules, and connected services are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: One Workflow for Every Photo
highlights.description: Booths, photographers, and uploads feed one pipeline, so no picture gets lost between systems and every output follows the same rules.

highlights.title: Plug In Any Service
highlights.description: Galleries, print shops, email, cloud storage, or the client's own systems connect through the same API, so adding a new output never means rebuilding the setup.

highlights.title: Built to Scale
highlights.description: Many capture points and channels run in parallel at a large event, without manual sorting, renaming, or uploading.

highlights.title: Extra Outputs
highlights.description: Add automatic branding per sponsor, retouching or background removal before delivery, a photo book or poster ordered from a print partner, or a QR code on every print that leads back to the digital gallery.

highlights.title: Photos Wherever They're Needed
highlights.description: Send conference portraits straight to the attendee app, deliver festival snapshots to a sponsor's social channel, archive museum visitor photos for the yearly report, or turn team photos from an offsite into a printed poster.

highlights.title: Know Which Photos Matter
highlights.description: Add a data layer that tracks photos processed, delivered, opened, and ordered per channel and product, showing which memories guests value enough to keep.

highlights.title: The Engine Behind the Photos
highlights.description: Pair with Memory Catcher and Connected Photographer as photo sources, with Shared Gallery for public display, with Photo Printing for prints on site, or with Journey Recap to deliver everything after the event.
